last_log.notes: Fresh granular surface — GRANULAR per-pair hot-cell view as the complement to both cross-cut rankings already shipped. P11.135/P11.136 per-partner ranking answers 'WHICH PARTNERS own the loudest cross-KPI signal?'; P11.137/P11.138 per-metric ranking answers 'WHICH KPIs own the loudest cross-partner signal?'; this module answers 'WHICH SPECIFIC (partner × KPI) CELLS drive both rankings?' by preserving pair-level granularity and ranking alert-worthy cells by hot_score. hot_score = |delta_rank| for improved/degraded with floor 1 (so delta_rank=0 classified alert-worthy still scores >0 above rotated/undecidable baseline); baseline 1 for rotated + undecidable. Tie-break: hot_score DESC → delta_rank ASC (most-negative first so degraded cells lead ties at the same magnitude — a degraded_by_2 is a louder ops signal than an improved_by_2) → reseller_code ASC → key ASC. Filters to alert-worthy transitions only (improved/degraded/rotated/undecidable); stable + first_classification never surface here (they already contribute to per-partner + per-metric bucket counts above; repeating them one-cell-per-row would flood the digest). Cron-route wiring deferred to P11.140 per pure-lib-first cadence.
